component.name: Toastty
component.summary: Terminal workspaces for running and following coding agents

description.p: Toastty organizes Ghostty-powered terminals into workspaces, tabs and splits, tracks managed coding agents (Claude Code, Codex and others) through their hooks, and keeps a right panel for a browser, local documents and Scratchpads. Remote Access lets the Toastty iOS app follow and answer sessions over Tailscale.
